note: Products sold directly on supply-shop.html (dropshipped). Add a checkoutUrl to turn a card's 'Coming soon' button into 'Buy now'. Run python3 tools/build_supply_shop.py after editing. Supplier links live in the Claude project doc, not this public repo.

items.name: Happy pill message capsules
items.caption: Bright little capsules with a rolled paper scroll tucked inside each one. Write a secret note, seal it in a pill and hand it over.
items.sideEffects: Grinning at a piece of paper.
items.alt: Colorful message capsules, each holding a tiny rolled paper note

items.name: Pocket pep talk crochet pal
items.caption: A tiny hand-crocheted potted buddy with its own pep talk card. Your pal's style is a surprise, and every one of them believes in you.
items.dosage: Keep one in a pocket. Squeeze when needed.
items.alt: Small crocheted flower pot buddies holding little encouragement cards

items.name: Glowing dumpling night lights
items.caption: Two squishy dumplings with sleepy little faces that glow in rainbow colors. The coziest snack you can't eat.
items.dosage: Tap once for a soft glow.
items.alt: Squishy dumpling-shaped night lights with smiling faces, glowing pink, yellow, green and blue

items.name: Butter stick squishy
items.caption: A squeezy stick of butter, wrapper and all, that slowly rises back into shape. Spread the stress, keep the toast.
items.alt: Yellow squishy toy shaped like a stick of butter in a wrapper

items.name: Cap gun bottle opener
items.caption: Pop the cap off your drink, then launch it across the room. A bottle opener that doubles as the party's main event.
items.alt: Handheld bottle opener that launches bottle caps
